error.no_serial_number: The device answered but reported no serial number.
error.unrecognized_inverter: The device answered with an unknown model code ({code}). Please open an issue with this code so the model can be added.

data_description.host: The hostname or IP address of the inverter, or of the Modbus TCP bridge it is connected through.
data_description.port: The Modbus TCP port to connect on. Sungrow inverters use 502.
data_description.unit_id: The inverter's Modbus unit ID, also called its Modbus device address. Usually 1.

user.description: Connect to the inverter over Modbus TCP. The model is detected automatically from its device type register.
